data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (converter, holidays, email with the matching subject and body), but it has small gaps: the recipient is a parameter instead of the fixed ops@example.com, the menu path is "Calendar > Holidays" instead of the "Holidays" menu, the mail tab switch is not mentioned, and it says "Send or discard" instead of "do not send, click Discard".
